summary: Off-registry unpinned git dependency executes arbitrary code at install time
details: package.json declares `whatsapp-rust-bridge-baron` as `git+https://github.com/7ucg/whatsapp-rust-bridge.git` — an unpinned git URL with no commit SHA and no tag. On `npm install`, npm fetches whatever the current HEAD of that repository returns and runs any lifecycle scripts inside it, with no integrity check and no version pinning. Whoever controls that GitHub repository controls install-time code execution on every machine that installs this package, and can change that code at any time without republishing to npm. The dependency name (`-baron` suffix) is also a sibling of the primary `whatsapp-rust-bridge` registry dependency listed alongside it, sourced entirely from a third-party GitHub account rather than the npm registry. Combined with the package's `@xrelly-stack/bails` scope resembling the Baileys WhatsApp library ecosystem, the manifest itself is the delivery vector regardless of the contents of the JavaScript shipped in the tarball.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
